name: Kakugara Shigehiro
source:
President of the Positive Academy.
He is also chairman of a financial group.

He used to be a social problem as a bad financier.
Later, he took over Kwang Jeong Gakuen, which was originally a traditional school.
By managing this school, he developed close relationships with influential people in the political and business world.
With the help of these influential people, the company gradually cleaned up its corporate image.
However, he has no intention of being satisfied with the status quo and has never lost his ambition.

[Translated from https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/torikonourara/]
